//go:build linux

// This executable is PID 1 inside the fixture initramfs. It must never mount or
// modify a host filesystem, including when invoked by root.
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

const (
	responsePrefix = "RFS-FIXTURE/1 "
	controlLimit   = 1024
	logLimit       = 16 << 20
	childStopGrace = 20 * time.Second
)

var bootKeys = []string{"RFS_FIXTURE_BOOT_TOKEN", "RFS_FIXTURE_NONCE", "RFS_FIXTURE_RUN_ID", "RFS_FIXTURE_VOLUME"}
var moduleNames = []string{"failover", "net_failover", "virtio_net", "virtio_blk", "virtio-rng"}

type fixtureConfig struct {
	SourceSHA string `json:"source_sha"`
	BootToken string `json:"boot_token"`
}

type identity struct {
	Config fixtureConfig
	Nonce  string
	RunID  string
	Volume string
}

type request struct {
	Nonce    string `json:"nonce"`
	Sequence uint64 `json:"sequence"`
	Command  string `json:"command"`
}

type response struct {
	RunID     string `json:"run_id"`
	SourceSHA string `json:"source_sha"`
	Nonce     string `json:"fixture_nonce"`
	Phase     string `json:"phase"`
	Sequence  uint64 `json:"sequence"`
	Op        string `json:"op"`
	Status    string `json:"status"`
	Category  string `json:"category,omitempty"`
	Cause     string `json:"cause,omitempty"`
	ExitCode  *int   `json:"exit_code,omitempty"`
}

type childExit struct {
	Code int
	Err  error
}

type child struct {
	Done     <-chan childExit
	Signal   func() error
	TermSent bool
}

// Every privileged operation is injected so safety tests can observe the exact
// first mutation without invoking mount, network ioctl, module load, or reboot.
type systemOps struct {
	PID         func() int
	UID         func() int
	EUID        func() int
	RootFS      func() (int64, error)
	ReadConfig  func() ([]byte, error)
	Environment func() []string
	CommandLine func() ([]byte, error)
	Mount       func(string, string, string, uintptr, string) error
	Console     func() error
	Module      func(string) error
	Network     func() error
	Volume      func() error
	Start       func([]string) (*child, error)
	Sync        func() error
	Unmount     func() error
	PowerOff    func() error
	After       func(time.Duration) <-chan time.Time
}

func lowerHex(value string, length int) bool {
	if len(value) != length {
		return false
	}
	for _, c := range value {
		if !(c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func safeID(value string) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 96 {
		return false
	}
	for _, c := range value {
		if !(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '_' || c == '-') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func strictObject(data []byte, target any) error {
	var fields []string
	switch target.(type) {
	case *fixtureConfig:
		fields = []string{"source_sha", "boot_token"}
	case *request:
		fields = []string{"nonce", "sequence", "command"}
	default:
		return errors.New("unsupported control object")
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	first, err := d.Token()
	if err != nil || first != json.Delim('{') {
		return errors.New("expected one JSON object")
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	for d.More() {
		key, err := d.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		name, ok := key.(string)
		if !ok || seen[name] {
			return errors.New("duplicate or invalid JSON key")
		}
		known := false
		for _, field := range fields {
			known = known || name == field
		}
		if !known {
			return errors.New("unknown JSON field")
		}
		seen[name] = true
		var value json.RawMessage
		if err := d.Decode(&value); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(value), []byte("null")) {
			return errors.New("null JSON values are forbidden")
		}
	}
	if _, err := d.Token(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := d.Token(); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("trailing JSON data")
	}
	if len(seen) != len(fields) {
		return errors.New("missing JSON field")
	}
	d = json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	return d.Decode(target)
}

func bootValues(entries []string) (map[string]string, error) {
	values := make(map[string]string, len(bootKeys))
	for _, item := range entries {
		key, value, ok := strings.Cut(item, "=")
		for _, expected := range bootKeys {
			if key == expected {
				if _, exists := values[key]; !ok || exists {
					return nil, errors.New("missing or duplicate fixture boot value")
				}
				values[key] = value
			}
		}
	}
	if len(values) != len(bootKeys) {
		return nil, errors.New("fixture boot values are incomplete")
	}
	return values, nil
}

func authorize(ops systemOps) (identity, error) {
	var id identity
	if ops.PID() != 1 || ops.UID() != 0 || ops.EUID() != 0 {
		return id, errors.New("fixture init requires PID 1 and real/effective UID 0")
	}
	kind, err := ops.RootFS()
	if err != nil {
		return id, fmt.Errorf("inspect initramfs: %w", err)
	}
	if kind != unix.RAMFS_MAGIC && kind != unix.TMPFS_MAGIC {
		return id, errors.New("fixture init requires a ramfs or tmpfs root")
	}
	data, err := ops.ReadConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return id, fmt.Errorf("read fixture config: %w", err)
	}
	if err := strictObject(data, &id.Config); err != nil {
		return id, fmt.Errorf("decode fixture config: %w", err)
	}
	if !lowerHex(id.Config.SourceSHA, 40) || !lowerHex(id.Config.BootToken, 64) {
		return id, errors.New("fixture config requires exact source SHA and boot token")
	}
	// Linux passes unknown NAME=value boot arguments to init's environment before
	// proc exists; names containing a dot do not have this behavior.
	// https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/adc218676eef25575469234709c2d87185ca223a/init/main.c#L540-L577
	values, err := bootValues(ops.Environment())
	if err != nil {
		return id, err
	}
	if values[bootKeys[0]] != id.Config.BootToken || !lowerHex(values[bootKeys[1]], 64) || !safeID(values[bootKeys[2]]) || !safeID(values[bootKeys[3]]) {
		return id, errors.New("fixture boot identity does not match the initramfs")
	}
	id.Nonce, id.RunID, id.Volume = values[bootKeys[1]], values[bootKeys[2]], values[bootKeys[3]]
	return id, nil
}

func boot(ops systemOps, id identity) error {
	if err := ops.Mount("proc", "/proc", "proc", unix.MS_NOSUID|unix.MS_NODEV|unix.MS_NOEXEC, ""); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("mount proc: %w", err)
	}
	line, err := ops.CommandLine()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("read kernel command line: %w", err)
	}
	values, err := bootValues(strings.Fields(string(line)))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	expected := []string{id.Config.BootToken, id.Nonce, id.RunID, id.Volume}
	for i, key := range bootKeys {
		if values[key] != expected[i] {
			return errors.New("kernel command line differs from fixture boot identity")
		}
	}
	if err := ops.Mount("devtmpfs", "/dev", "devtmpfs", unix.MS_NOSUID, "mode=0755"); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("mount devtmpfs: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ops.Mount("sysfs", "/sys", "sysfs", unix.MS_NOSUID|unix.MS_NODEV|unix.MS_NOEXEC, ""); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("mount sysfs: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ops.Console(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("configure serial console: %w", err)
	}
	for _, module := range moduleNames {
		if err := ops.Module("/modules/" + module + ".ko"); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("load module %s: %w", module, err)
		}
	}
	if err := ops.Network(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("configure guest network: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ops.Mount("/dev/vda", "/data", "ext4", unix.MS_NOSUID|unix.MS_NODEV|unix.MS_NOEXEC, "errors=remount-ro"); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("mount authority disk: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ops.Volume(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("prepare authority volume: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

type incoming struct {
	Request request
	Err     error
	Advance chan struct{}
}

func readRequests(input io.Reader, done <-chan struct{}) <-chan incoming {
	result := make(chan incoming)
	go func() {
		reader := bufio.NewReaderSize(input, controlLimit)
		for {
			line, err := reader.ReadSlice('\n')
			var req request
			if err == nil && len(line) <= controlLimit {
				err = strictObject(line, &req)
			} else if errors.Is(err, bufio.ErrBufferFull) || len(line) > controlLimit {
				err = errors.New("control message exceeds 1024 bytes")
			} else if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
				err = errors.New("control channel closed before shutdown")
			}
			advance := make(chan struct{})
			select {
			case result <- incoming{Request: req, Err: err, Advance: advance}:
			case <-done:
				return
			}
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			select {
			case <-advance:
			case <-done:
				return
			}
		}
	}()
	return result
}

type supervisor struct {
	ops         systemOps
	id          identity
	emit        func(response) error
	logErrors   <-chan error
	child       *child
	everStarted bool
	sequence    uint64
	phase       string
	lastExit    *int
	mounted     bool
}

func (s *supervisor) response(op, status string, err error) error {
	r := response{RunID: s.id.RunID, SourceSHA: s.id.Config.SourceSHA, Nonce: s.id.Nonce, Phase: s.phase,
		Sequence: s.sequence, Op: op, Status: status, ExitCode: s.lastExit}
	if err != nil {
		r.Category = "guest-lifecycle"
		r.Cause = err.Error()
		if len(r.Cause) > 256 {
			r.Cause = r.Cause[:256] + " [truncated]"
		}
	}
	return s.emit(r)
}

func (s *supervisor) childExited(result childExit) error {
	s.child = nil
	s.lastExit = &result.Code
	if result.Err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("authority exit %d: %w", result.Code, result.Err)
	}
	if result.Code != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("authority exit %d", result.Code)
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *supervisor) stop() error {
	select {
	case result := <-s.child.Done:
		return errors.Join(errors.New("authority exited before stop"), s.childExited(result))
	default:
	}
	if !s.child.TermSent {
		s.child.TermSent = true
		if err := s.child.Signal(); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("signal authority: %w", err)
		}
	}
	select {
	case result := <-s.child.Done:
		return s.childExited(result)
	case <-s.ops.After(childStopGrace):
		return errors.New("authority did not exit within 20 seconds after SIGTERM")
	}
}

func (s *supervisor) finishDisk() error {
	if !s.mounted {
		return nil
	}
	if err := s.ops.Sync(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("sync authority disk: %w", err)
	}
	if err := s.ops.Unmount(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("unmount authority disk: %w", err)
	}
	s.mounted = false
	return nil
}

func authorityArgs(volume string, initialize bool) []string {
	args := []string{"-listen", "10.0.2.15:8080", "-local-store", "/data/volume", "-volume", volume, "-quota", "64M"}
	if initialize {
		args = append(args, "-initialize-lock-state")
	}
	return args
}

func (s *supervisor) run(input io.ReadCloser) error {
	done := make(chan struct{})
	defer close(done)
	defer input.Close()
	requests := readRequests(input, done)
	for {
		var exits <-chan childExit
		if s.child != nil {
			exits = s.child.Done
		}
		select {
		case err := <-s.logErrors:
			return err
		case result := <-exits:
			return errors.Join(errors.New("authority exited unexpectedly"), s.childExited(result))
		case message := <-requests:
			if message.Err != nil {
				return message.Err
			}
			select {
			case result := <-exits:
				return errors.Join(errors.New("authority exited unexpectedly"), s.childExited(result))
			default:
			}
			req := message.Request
			if req.Nonce != s.id.Nonce || s.sequence == ^uint64(0) || req.Sequence != s.sequence+1 {
				return errors.New("control nonce or sequence mismatch")
			}
			s.sequence, s.phase = req.Sequence, req.Command
			switch req.Command {
			case "start":
				if s.child != nil {
					return errors.New("authority is already running")
				}
				args := authorityArgs(s.id.Volume, !s.everStarted)
				s.everStarted = true
				var err error
				s.child, err = s.ops.Start(args)
				if err != nil {
					return fmt.Errorf("start authority: %w", err)
				}
				s.lastExit = nil
			case "stop-authority":
				if s.child == nil {
					return errors.New("authority is not running")
				}
				if err := s.stop(); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			case "shutdown":
				if s.child != nil {
					if err := s.stop(); err != nil {
						return err
					}
				}
				if err := s.finishDisk(); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := s.pendingLogError(); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := s.response(req.Command, "ok", nil); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := s.ops.PowerOff(); err != nil {
					return fmt.Errorf("power off guest: %w", err)
				}
				return errors.New("power off returned without stopping the guest")
			default:
				return errors.New("unknown control command")
			}
			if err := s.pendingLogError(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := s.response(req.Command, "ok", nil); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			close(message.Advance)
		}
	}
}

func (s *supervisor) pendingLogError() error {
	select {
	case err := <-s.logErrors:
		return err
	default:
		return nil
	}
}

// Failure cleanup cannot produce a successful shutdown acknowledgement. In
// particular, an unconfirmed child exit never permits an ext4 unmount.
func (s *supervisor) failure(err error) {
	if emitErr := s.response("failure", "error", err); emitErr != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "fixture failure response: %v\n", emitErr)
	}
	if cleanupErr := s.cleanupFailure(); cleanupErr != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "fixture failure cleanup: %v\n", cleanupErr)
	}
	if powerErr := s.ops.PowerOff(); powerErr != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "fixture poweroff: %v\n", powerErr)
	}
	// PID 1 must not return, including if reboot fails. The owning controller
	// enforces its deadline and terminates its own QEMU job on this path.
	select {}
}

func (s *supervisor) cleanupFailure() (returned error) {
	if s.child != nil {
		returned = s.stop()
	}
	if s.child == nil {
		returned = errors.Join(returned, s.finishDisk())
	}
	return returned
}

type consoleOutput struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	writer io.Writer
	errors chan error
}

func (out *consoleOutput) write(data []byte) error {
	out.mu.Lock()
	defer out.mu.Unlock()
	n, err := out.writer.Write(data)
	if err == nil && n != len(data) {
		err = io.ErrShortWrite
	}
	return err
}

func (out *consoleOutput) emit(r response) error {
	data, err := json.Marshal(r)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	frame := []byte(responsePrefix + string(data) + "\n")
	if len(frame) > controlLimit {
		return errors.New("fixture response exceeds 1024 bytes")
	}
	return out.write(frame)
}

type authorityOutput struct {
	out    *consoleOutput
	name   string
	bytes  int
	failed bool
}

func (log *authorityOutput) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	if log.failed {
		return 0, errors.New("authority log stream already failed")
	}
	frame := []byte("RFS-AUTHORITY/" + log.name + " " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data) + "\n")
	var err error
	if log.bytes+len(frame) > logLimit {
		err = errors.New("authority " + log.name + " exceeds 16 MiB [truncated]")
	} else {
		err = log.out.write(frame)
	}
	if err != nil {
		log.failed = true
		select {
		case log.out.errors <- err:
		default:
		}
		return 0, err
	}
	log.bytes += len(frame)
	return len(data), nil
}

func readFixtureConfig(path string) (data []byte, returned error) {
	fd, err := unix.Open(path, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_CLOEXEC|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_NONBLOCK, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), path)
	defer func() { returned = errors.Join(returned, file.Close()) }()
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if err := unix.Fstat(fd, &stat); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateConfigFile(stat); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 4097))
}

func validateConfigFile(stat unix.Stat_t) error {
	if stat.Mode != unix.S_IFREG|0400 || stat.Uid != 0 || stat.Gid != 0 || stat.Nlink != 1 || stat.Size > 4096 || stat.Size < 0 {
		return errors.New("fixture config must be a root-owned 0400 regular file with one link and at most 4096 bytes")
	}
	return nil
}

func configureConsole() error {
	fd := int(os.Stdin.Fd())
	termios, err := unix.IoctlGetTermios(fd, unix.TCGETS)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	termios.Iflag &^= unix.IGNBRK | unix.BRKINT | unix.PARMRK | unix.ISTRIP | unix.INLCR | unix.IGNCR | unix.ICRNL | unix.IXON
	termios.Oflag &^= unix.OPOST
	termios.Lflag &^= unix.ECHO | unix.ECHONL | unix.ICANON | unix.ISIG | unix.IEXTEN
	termios.Cflag &^= unix.CSIZE | unix.PARENB
	termios.Cflag |= unix.CS8 | unix.CLOCAL | unix.CREAD
	termios.Cc[unix.VMIN], termios.Cc[unix.VTIME] = 1, 0
	return unix.IoctlSetTermios(fd, unix.TCSETS, termios)
}

func loadModule(path string) (returned error) {
	fd, err := unix.Open(path, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_CLOEXEC|unix.O_NOFOLLOW, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { returned = errors.Join(returned, unix.Close(fd)) }()
	return unix.FinitModule(fd, "", 0)
}

func configureNetwork() (returned error) {
	fd, err := unix.Socket(unix.AF_INET, unix.SOCK_DGRAM|unix.SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { returned = errors.Join(returned, unix.Close(fd)) }()
	for _, network := range []struct {
		name          string
		address, mask []byte
	}{
		{"lo", []byte{127, 0, 0, 1}, []byte{255, 0, 0, 0}},
		{"eth0", []byte{10, 0, 2, 15}, []byte{255, 255, 255, 0}},
	} {
		req, err := unix.NewIfreq(network.name)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := req.SetInet4Addr(network.address); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := unix.IoctlIfreq(fd, unix.SIOCSIFADDR, req); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("set %s address: %w", network.name, err)
		}
		if err := req.SetInet4Addr(network.mask); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := unix.IoctlIfreq(fd, unix.SIOCSIFNETMASK, req); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("set %s mask: %w", network.name, err)
		}
		if err := unix.IoctlIfreq(fd, unix.SIOCGIFFLAGS, req); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		req.SetUint16(req.Uint16() | unix.IFF_UP)
		if err := unix.IoctlIfreq(fd, unix.SIOCSIFFLAGS, req); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("bring up %s: %w", network.name, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

type volumeOps struct {
	StatFS    func(string, *unix.Statfs_t) error
	Lstat     func(string, *unix.Stat_t) error
	ReadNames func(string) ([]string, error)
	Mkdir     func(string, os.FileMode) error
	Chown     func(string, int, int) error
}

func realVolumeOps() volumeOps {
	return volumeOps{StatFS: unix.Statfs, Lstat: unix.Lstat, Mkdir: os.Mkdir, Chown: os.Chown,
		ReadNames: func(path string) ([]string, error) {
			entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			names := make([]string, len(entries))
			for i, entry := range entries {
				names[i] = entry.Name()
			}
			return names, nil
		},
	}
}

func verifyPrivateParent(path string, lstat func(string, *unix.Stat_t) error) error {
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if err := lstat(path, &stat); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT != unix.S_IFDIR || stat.Mode&0022 != 0 || stat.Uid != 0 || stat.Gid != 0 {
		return errors.New("authority disk parent must be a root-owned directory without group or other write access")
	}
	return nil
}

func prepareVolume(path string, fs volumeOps) error {
	var stat unix.Statfs_t
	if err := fs.StatFS(path, &stat); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if stat.Type != unix.EXT4_SUPER_MAGIC || stat.Flags&unix.ST_RDONLY != 0 {
		return errors.New("authority disk must be writable ext4")
	}
	if err := verifyPrivateParent(path, fs.Lstat); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	entries, err := fs.ReadNames(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry != "lost+found" {
			return errors.New("authority disk is not pristine")
		}
		if err := verifyPrivateParent(path+"/lost+found", fs.Lstat); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		contents, err := fs.ReadNames(path + "/lost+found")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if len(contents) != 0 {
			return errors.New("authority disk contains recovered files")
		}
	}
	volume := path + "/volume"
	if err := fs.Mkdir(volume, 0700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := fs.Chown(volume, 1000, 1000); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var volumeStat unix.Stat_t
	if err := fs.Lstat(volume, &volumeStat); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if volumeStat.Mode != unix.S_IFDIR|0700 || volumeStat.Uid != 1000 || volumeStat.Gid != 1000 {
		return errors.New("authority volume must be owned by UID/GID 1000 with mode 0700")
	}
	return nil
}

func realOps(out *consoleOutput) systemOps {
	stdout := &authorityOutput{out: out, name: "stdout"}
	stderr := &authorityOutput{out: out, name: "stderr"}
	return systemOps{
		PID: os.Getpid, UID: os.Getuid, EUID: os.Geteuid,
		RootFS: func() (int64, error) {
			var stat unix.Statfs_t
			if err := unix.Statfs("/", &stat); err != nil {
				return 0, err
			}
			return int64(stat.Type), nil
		},
		ReadConfig:  func() ([]byte, error) { return readFixtureConfig("/fixture-config.json") },
		Environment: os.Environ,
		CommandLine: func() ([]byte, error) {
			file, err := os.Open("/proc/cmdline")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			data, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 4097))
			closeErr := file.Close()
			if len(data) > 4096 {
				readErr = errors.Join(readErr, errors.New("kernel command line exceeds 4096 bytes"))
			}
			return data, errors.Join(readErr, closeErr)
		},
		Mount: unix.Mount, Console: configureConsole, Module: loadModule, Network: configureNetwork,
		Volume: func() error { return prepareVolume("/data", realVolumeOps()) },
		Start: func(args []string) (*child, error) {
			cmd := exec.Command("/remote-fs-server", args...)
			cmd.Dir = "/data/volume"
			cmd.Env = []string{"TMPDIR=/tmp"}
			cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Credential: &syscall.Credential{Uid: 1000, Gid: 1000, Groups: []uint32{}}}
			cmd.Stdout = stdout
			cmd.Stderr = stderr
			cmd.WaitDelay = 2 * time.Second
			if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			done := make(chan childExit, 1)
			go func() {
				err := cmd.Wait()
				done <- childExit{Code: cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode(), Err: err}
			}()
			return &child{Done: done, Signal: func() error { return cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM) }}, nil
		},
		Sync: func() (returned error) {
			fd, err := unix.Open("/data", unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			defer func() { returned = errors.Join(returned, unix.Close(fd)) }()
			if err := unix.Syncfs(fd); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			unix.Sync()
			return nil
		},
		Unmount: func() error { return unix.Unmount("/data", 0) },
		PowerOff: func() error {
			if err := unix.IoctlSetInt(int(os.Stdout.Fd()), unix.TCSBRK, 1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return unix.Reboot(unix.LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_POWER_OFF)
		},
		After: time.After,
	}
}

func main() {
	out := &consoleOutput{writer: os.Stdout, errors: make(chan error, 1)}
	ops := realOps(out)
	id, err := authorize(ops)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "fixture init refused: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	s := &supervisor{ops: ops, id: id, emit: out.emit, logErrors: out.errors, phase: "boot"}
	mount := ops.Mount
	ops.Mount = func(source, target, kind string, flags uintptr, data string) error {
		err := mount(source, target, kind, flags, data)
		if err == nil && target == "/data" {
			s.mounted = true
		}
		return err
	}
	if err := boot(ops, id); err != nil {
		s.failure(err)
	}
	if err := s.response("boot-ready", "ok", nil); err != nil {
		s.failure(err)
	}
	s.failure(s.run(os.Stdin))
}
